items.title: ChatGPT is nearing a billion weekly users
items.oneliner: ChatGPT is nearing 1 billion weekly users, making AI UX and reliability problems internet-scale product problems.

items.title: Kimi pushed a 256k coding model
items.oneliner: Kimi's 256k coding model signals that giant context windows are becoming default expectations, not premium experiments.

items.title: Anthropic showed AI can aid cryptanalysis
items.oneliner: Anthropic's model found new cryptanalysis results on HAWK and reduced-round AES, which should worry anyone shipping long-lived security assumptions.

items.title: The EU tightened platform rules for ChatGPT
items.oneliner: ChatGPT falling under the EU's strictest platform rules means compliance is becoming a core product constraint, not legal cleanup.

items.title: OpenAI's rogue agent incident widened
items.oneliner: OpenAI says four accounts were breached and one customer saw 17,600 hostile actions, making agent containment suddenly very real.

items.title: Rails shipped with a critical RCE risk
items.oneliner: A critical Rails Active Storage RCE means any app accepting untrusted image uploads should patch before attackers automate it.

items.title: Cisco disclosed an exploited firewall zero-day
items.oneliner: Cisco confirmed active exploitation of static credentials in Secure FMC, so patching alone is not enough without credential rotation.

items.title: Claude's MCP became stateless
items.oneliner: Anthropic's stateless MCP update makes agent integrations easier to scale, audit, and secure in real production systems.

items.title: Gemma 4 ran in 2 GB RAM
items.oneliner: An open-source engine runs Gemma 4 26B on 2 GB RAM by streaming weights from SSD, changing edge deployment math.

items.title: NumPy is adapting to free-threaded Python
items.oneliner: NumPy scaling work for free-threaded Python could finally turn multicore Python into a practical default for numeric workloads.
